//regions: Functions run next to the database, not next to the users.
Supabase is in ap-northeast-1 (Tokyo). Without this, functions defaulted to
iad1 (Washington DC), so every query went NZ -> Sydney edge -> Virginia ->
Tokyo and back. The arithmetic for a page making N sequential queries from
region R is: 185ms floor + RTT(NZ->R) + N * RTT(R->Tokyo).
syd1 only wins for a function that makes NO database call at all, and there
isn't one. hnd1 also makes an extra sequential query cost ~2ms instead of
170ms, which is why the admin stopped feeling laggy rather than just getting
faster. This moves FUNCTIONS only — static marketing pages stay on the CDN
and are still served from Sydney.
